snippet.title: THE FACELESS MAN - OFFICIAL GAMEPLAY TRAILER
snippet.description:
PLAY THE GAME HERE: https://skyward-gamess.itch.io/the-faceless-man
THE FACELESS MAN - OFFICIAL GAMEPLAY TRAILER

Experience the intense journey of an unsolved mystery involving someone who fell into the clutches of the intriguing legend known as "The Faceless Man." Immerse yourself in this first-person horror game, carefully inspired by ancient creepypastas, where each step takes you deeper into the dark and mysterious plot.

👉 Itch.io: https://skyward-gamess.itch.io/the-faceless-man
🐦 Twitter: https://twitter.com/skyward_games
☕ Ko-Fi: https://ko-fi.com/skywardgames
🌟 Patreon: patreon.com/SKYWARDGames_

Who are we? We are an indie game studio composed of two creative minds: an Unreal developer and a game designer. We've already released a series of small retro games on Itch.io, and we have many exciting projects ahead.

Follow us on our social media channels to stay updated on the latest news and consider supporting us financially to fuel our passionate work ❤️. Be part of this terrifying and thrilling journey with us!
